name: PhDriveFile
description: A file node's content: an attachment reference plus metadata, used by the ph-drive Google-Drive-style sync.

global.schema:
type PhDriveFileState {
  content: AttachmentRef
  mimeType: String
  size: Int
  sha256: String
  parentFolder: String
}

modules.name: content
modules.description: Set the attachment reference and metadata for a file.

operations.name: SET_FILE_CONTENT
operations.description: Attach (or replace) the file's content via an attachment ref.
operations.schema:
input SetFileContentInput {
  content: AttachmentRef!
  mimeType: String!
  size: Int!
  sha256: String!
  parentFolder: String
}
